title: OXR acceptance probability
statement: For a natural number $n$, let $\delta\in[0,1]$ and let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $[-1,1]$. Define its acceptance probability to be the expectation, over the correlated triple-cube sample with parameter $\delta$, of the OXR predicate's randomized value on the three function values at the sample's query points.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ takes values in $[-1,1]$ on the sign cube
caveat: The formal statement uses the OXR predicate's randomized-value operation, whose definition is not included in the supplied context.
